page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.g5 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 64 dedicated physical cores with 64 vCPUs, utilizing a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. It is provisioned with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type runs on the KVM hypervisor. It does not include any local storage, meaning storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU accelerators.

Given its 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.g5.16xlarge is positioned as a general-purpose instance. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention. This resource density makes it suitable for enterprise applications, web serving, mid-sized databases, and general-purpose workloads that require a balance of compute power and memory without the need for local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
